git commit：暂存内容进入新提交；未暂存编辑仍留在工作区。: git commit: record the staged content. Unstaged edits stay in the working tree.
git restore --staged README.md：暂存区回到 HEA: git restore --staged README.md: restore the index from HEAD and keep working-tree edits.
git restore README.md：用暂存内容覆盖工作区；未暂存编辑被丢: git restore README.md: overwrite the working tree from the index, discarding unstaged edits.
